section.title: Free learning path
section.description: Test what you know from different angles: TRM, QMT, MBD and the EXETAT.

title: Free learning path — Reasoning tests
description: After your lessons, measure what you have retained from different angles. Choose a test and see where you stand.

trm.title: TRM — Mathematical Reasoning Test
trm.description: Check your logic: sequences, proportions and multi-step problems.

qmt.title: QMT — Mbuyamba Quantitative Test
qmt.description: Measure how comfortable you are with numbers, percentages and data.

mbd.title: MBD — Foundations and Deduction Measure
mbd.description: Test your foundations and your ability to reason on new problems.

exetat.title: EXETAT — State Examination
exetat.description: Preparation for the mathematics papers of the DRC State Examination.
